steps.what: Check actual stock, expiry dates and outstanding supply orders
Choose the supplies and quantities needed for restocking
Prepare orders using the chosen restock lines and supplier details
Check the final order quantities, units, supplier, price and delivery address
Send the checked final supply order to the supplier

tasks.design: Configure catalogue favourites and repeat-order fields in {PROCUREMENT}, then use its native supplier send after the assistant checks the final order. Stock observation, quantity choice and all unit, price and address checks remain human; no automatic reorder rule is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stable catalogue and delivery fields are re-entered and the completed order is manually attached and addressed.
tasks.enabler_now: Native repeat-order forms and a gated supplier send can remove those specific operations.
tasks.still_hard: Stock condition, pack sizes and forthcoming clinical needs can change the right quantity.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant notices damaged or expiring stock and avoids an inappropriate substitute.
tasks.altitude: Less order assembly leaves more attention for stock condition and pack-size checking.

reach.task: Check supply availability and restocking details

evidence.claim: Native procurement favourites, repeat-order forms and gated supplier sends can reduce repeated entry and transmission handling; savings are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary includes stock checking, quantity choice, real order writing, final checking and the external send. Existing purchasing delegation is assumed; no new approval hierarchy is invented.

The assistant produces usable stock and expiry observations in s1 and chosen quantities in s2, retaining all40 hours. The purchasing master-data owner produces supplier identifiers, catalogue units and delivery addresses; the assistant captures and checks item, quantity, unit, price, supplier and address in s3-s4, retaining15.75 entry and15 checking hours. Missing master data or unclear units require manual ordering.
No structured par level or sold-out flag feeds a rule. Test native repeat orders and supplier-send support before code.

s5 sends only the final immutable order checked in s4; any field or recipient change cancels release. Send failures return to the assistant and are covered by upkeep. An ordinary author save earns no saving.
unknowns: Actual repeat-order entry and attachment-send time
research_questions: How much entry and real transmission work remains after unit and address checks?

already_counted.description: Stock observation, quantity choice, changed-field entry and final authorization

incremental.description: Resolve send failures and correct catalogue or delivery mappings

approvals.approved_version: The exact final order version including item, quantity, unit, price, supplier and delivery address checked in s4; any change voids release

High: compatible repeat lines remove15 entry hours and a real native send removes seven handling hours, R78 plus2 upkeep, net20; all stock and final checks remain.

steps.what: Discuss the customer's pet-food or supply request
Check product details, current price and any relevant veterinary instruction
Select the requested product and check the actual pack
Enter the sale and check item, quantity and price in the till
Take payment and sell the checked supplies to the customer

tasks.design: Configure product favourites and a linked current-price view in the {OTHER} veterinary point-of-sale system. The assistant keeps the customer conversation and pack selection human, writes the till transaction separately and checks it before payment and handover.
tasks.previous_blocker: Product codes and prices are searched separately during a sale.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue views and till favourites may remove repeated navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Similar packaging can conceal a different diet or pack size.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant recognizes when the request needs a veterinarian's advice rather than an improvised recommendation.
tasks.altitude: A little less till navigation leaves more attention for the customer's question.

reach.task: Check requested products against the authorised catalogue

evidence.claim: Native product favourites and current-price views can reduce till navigation while retaining pack and transaction checks.

assumptions: Boundary includes the actual sale entry, customer conversation, product selection, payment and handover. No routine sales-conversation note is added.

The catalogue owner produces item code, pack size and current price; the assistant establishes the request in s1 and checks actual item and quantity in s3-s4. Retained seven lookup hours and17.5 entry hours count all source checking, capture and transaction verification. Missing product matches use manual till entry and clinical questions go to the veterinarian.
OTHER means the veterinary point-of-sale system. Test its native favourites before code. No free stock flag, clinical recommendation or automatic customer send is assumed.
The ordinary author transaction save has no gate and no saving; existing arithmetic and receipt runtime earn no new labour saving.
unknowns: Current catalogue layout and till-entry time
research_questions: Do favourites remove search time without raising wrong-pack or wrong-diet corrections?

already_counted.description: Customer dialogue, product checks, transaction capture and payment handover

incremental.description: Correct product favourites and stale price-view references

approvals.approved_version: The actual product questions and explanations spoken to this customer, checked within role as spoken
The final checked item, pack, quantity, price, tender and receipt for this customer; changes require checking again

High: a usable catalogue view saves1.5 lookup hours and favourites save five transaction-entry hours, R93.5 plus0.5 upkeep, net6; dialogue, pack selection and payment remain65 hours.

tasks.short: Assist with anesthesia and record animal responses

steps.what: Check the animal, veterinary anesthetic order and delegated role
Prepare the ordered anesthetic and monitoring equipment under supervision
Administer anesthetics only within the actual veterinary order and delegation
Monitor the effects on animals and communicate changes to the veterinarian
Write actual administered amounts, times and observations in the anesthesia record

tasks.design: Use the existing anesthesia-record template in the {OTHER} veterinary practice system to reuse stable animal and procedure headings. Keep order checks, preparation, administration, observation and communication fully human, and price the actual anesthesia writing separately.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stable case headings are repeated around a largely hands-on procedure.
tasks.enabler_now: A native anesthesia form may reduce those headings without removing actual observations or administered-dose entries.
tasks.still_hard: An animal's response can change rapidly and requires supervised clinical attention.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant notices actual changes and promptly communicates them to the veterinarian.
tasks.altitude: Only a small documentation saving is plausible; supervision and clinical responsibility do not change.

reach.task: Prepare and check monitoring equipment within role

evidence.claim: Native anesthesia-record headings can reduce repeated stable-case entry; neither a human-care scribe study nor this estimate establishes veterinary automation.

assumptions: Boundary retains the task's administration only where it already falls within actual delegation and supervision. This design changes documentation alone and adds no drug selection, dose calculation or machine control.

OTHER means the veterinary practice system. The veterinarian produces the order and the assistant checks identity and delegation in s1. The assistant produces actual amount, administration time, observation time and observed response in s3-s4 and enters them in s5; all85 clinical hours and12 retained documentation hours count that capture and checking. Missing values are verified manually, never inferred from the order.

Monitoring and entries repeat during surgery; the ordered steps describe the first cycle rather than postponing all charting until surgery ends. No unproduced structured animal-status flag, sensor feed or automatic alert is used.
Test native anesthesia forms before code. The author's internal save has no self-approval gate or save-time saving. No new report or external send is added.
unknowns: Actual local delegation and current anesthesia chart format
Time spent on stable headings rather than actual observations
research_questions: Does a native form remove only repeated headings while preserving timely actual-dose and observation entries?

already_counted.description: All supervised clinical work and actual anesthesia record capture

incremental.description: Correct anesthesia-form headings and identity links

High: compatible animal and procedure headings remove two entry hours, R98 plus0.5 upkeep, net1.5; all actual administration and observation work remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce repeated order, till and chart fields while protecting animal care and accurate observations.
role.ambitious_version: A veterinary assistant with less repetitive paperwork and more attention for animals, customers and reliable supplies.
